forgeResults.notes: All 15 invariant properties + 2 direct vulnerability proof tests passed under Foundry fuzzer.

invariants.name: invariant_INV1b_sumOfClientPrincipalsEqualsTotal
invariants.description: Sum of all per-client principalOf() values equals getTotalDeposited()

invariants.name: invariant_INV1c_ghostPerClientMatchesStrategy
invariants.description: Per-client ghost principal matches strategy principalOf() for each client

invariants.name: invariant_INV2_solvency
invariants.description: Held vault share value (at current NAV) >= total recorded principal (dust tolerance: 3e4 wei)
invariants.medusa: PASS (note: INV-5 in Medusa targets same property post-emergencyWithdraw and FAILS)

invariants.name: invariant_INV3_noPrincipalInflation
invariants.description: No phantom credit injected: ghost total equals contract total after all operations

invariants.name: invariant_INV3b_noClientExceedsTotal
invariants.description: No single client principal exceeds aggregate total (cross-client attribution bug check)

invariants.name: invariant_INV4a_withdrawalStateMachineForward
invariants.description: Withdrawal status after each totalWithdrawal() call is the expected legal successor

invariants.name: invariant_INV4b_executedWithdrawalFullyReset
invariants.description: After Phase 2 execution: status=None, initiatedAt=0, cachedBalance=0

invariants.name: invariant_INV4c_allStatusesValid
invariants.description: All client withdrawal statuses are valid enum values (0-3)

invariants.name: invariant_INV5_solvencyAfterEmergencyWithdraw
invariants.description: After emergencyWithdraw(), held share value must still cover totalDeposited. Probes CODE-003/ECON-007.
invariants.forge: PASS (fuzzer did not find emergencyWithdraw path in invariant-only run)

invariants.name: invariant_INV6_totalWithdrawalCachedBalanceAccuracy
invariants.description: Cached balance at Phase 1 must not exceed current principal (probes CODE-001 inter-phase deposit path)
invariants.medusa: N/A (time-gated path not fully reachable in Medusa without vm.warp)

invariants.name: invariant_INV7_strategyHoldsNoUnderlying
invariants.description: Strategy holds 0 underlying tokens after each operation

invariants.name: test_CODE003_emergencyWithdrawLeavesNonZeroPrincipal
invariants.description: Direct proof: emergencyWithdraw() transfers all shares to owner without zeroing clientBalances, creating provable insolvency

invariants.name: test_CODE001_depositAsOwnerBetweenPhasesAltersCachedBalance
invariants.description: Direct proof: depositAsOwner() between Phase 1 and Phase 2 causes _totalWithdraw to use live clientBalances (not cached amount), extracting more than announced
invariants.forge: PASS (assertion confirmed CODE-001 behavior: actualReceived == 6000 > announced 1000)

failures.description: emergencyWithdraw() transfers vault shares to owner but does NOT zero clientBalances[token][client] or totalDeposited[token]. After the call, the strategy holds fewer shares than needed to cover recorded principal, making it insolvent.

sequence: depositForClient(seed, amount) -- deposits principal, records clientBalances

forgeCounterexamples.description: emergencyWithdraw() zeroes strategy shares but not client principal. Demonstrated directly: after 1000e18 deposit and full emergencyWithdraw, strategy holds 0 shares, principalOf returns 1000e18, heldValue (0) < totalDeposited (1000e18).

_totalWithdraw reads live clientBalances not cached Phase-1 balance. Demonstrated: 1000e18 deposit -> Phase 1 caches 1000 -> depositAsOwner(5000) interleaved -> Phase 2 uses live balance 6000 -> owner receives 6000e18 (not announced 1000e18). The cached balance from Phase 1 is ignored by _totalWithdraw which reads clientStoredBalance = clientBalances[token][client] fresh.
